Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravi V Hosmani
 Oral Judgment

When matter was listed for non-compliance of office objections for sixth time, this Court on 08.04.2025, granted four weeks' time as finally for compliance of office objections and in case of non-compliance, ordered matter to be listed for dismissal.
Till date, office objections are not complied.
This would indicate that appellant is not diligently pursuing appeal.
Hence, appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
